methods.name: Standard Delivery
methods.cost: Free on orders above ₹499, otherwise ₹50 standard shipping charge applies.

methods.name: Express Delivery
methods.cost: Flat ₹150 for expedited shipping (available at checkout).

shipping.tracking: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking link via SMS and email. You can also track your order here anytime by typing 'Track my order' or providing your order ID.
shipping.locations: We ship all across India, covering over 19,000 pin codes. Currently, we do not support international shipping directly through the website.
shipping.handling_time: Orders are processed and dispatched within 24-48 hours of placement (excluding Sundays and national holidays).
